text:
Maya Chen (CS): Post-onboard catch: compiling the list of product asks we promised ClearHarbor during the enablement call.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Thanks Maya. Paste raw bullets and we'll triage.
Maya Chen (CS): Raw from notes: 
- Request: tenant-scoped model pin + freeze toggle in Console (they want to pause auto-rollouts during audit windows).
- Request: simple per-route cost labels + downloadable CSV for finance reconciliation.
- Request: a tiny latency SLA for low-volume endpoints (they're using per-customer microservices and saw 2x TTFB variance).
- Pain: private deploy audit logs don't include user_id header consistently when proxied through their sidecar.
- Ask: enablement workbook + 30-min follow-up Q&A for their SREs.
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Noted. For latency: possible causes are cold-kernel compile and container spin-up. Short-term: warm cache (keep a minimal worker warm) or prefetch on first deploy. Long-term: reduce JIT latency.
Nora Diaz (Product): Priorities from customer perspective: cost CSV (procurement) and model-freeze (compliance) are must-haves for renewal. Latency is a commercial risk but lower priority than billing and compliance.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Proposed priority list: 
1) Cost labels + CSV export -> P0 -> owner: Ethan Rivera -> ETA: 2w -> reason: finance needs for renewal
2) Console model-freeze toggle -> P0 -> owner: Nora Diaz -> ETA: 4w -> reason: compliance/rollout safety
3) Audit-log user_id passthrough spec -> P1 -> owner: Maya Chen -> ETA: 1w to spec, then eng backlog
4) Warm-worker pilot for low-traffic tenants -> P1 -> owner: Harpreet Singh -> ETA: 2w pilot
5) Enablement workbook + Q&A -> P1 -> owner: Maya Chen -> ETA: next Tue session
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Engineering estimates: CSV + labels backend + S3 export endpoint ~5 dev-days; Console UI for label mapping ~3 dev-days. Model-freeze backend + policy engine ~10 dev-days, UI ~5 dev-days. Audit header passthrough easy if just proxying (~1 dev-day), more if signing/KMS involved (~3-4 dev-days). Warm-worker pilot infra changes ~7 dev-days including autoscaler tweak.
ci-bot: Created ticket CH-2201: "ClearHarbor billing export & per-route labels" assigned to Ethan Rivera due 2w.
Maya Chen (CS): Please add acceptance criteria: finance needs CSV with columns: date, route, token_count, cost_cents, customer_note. Also include timezone handling.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Added acceptance criteria to CH-2201. Will draft a short PRD today.
Nora Diaz (Product): I'll mock the model-freeze flow and link to the rollout docs. ETA EOD Thu.
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Maya, can you upload example traces showing the TTFB spikes and a sample of their sidecar config? That will help scope.
Maya Chen (CS): Uploading call recording + traces to /customers/clearharbor/onboard now. Scheduling SRE enablement Q&A for Tue 10am.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Can we also include a tiny smoke-test prompt set for regressions? Even 8-10 prompts covering short/long/structured inputs will do.
Maya Chen (CS): Will include smoke-test prompts and a basic test matrix for the team.
Nora Diaz (Product): Note: customer asked whether model-freeze can be role-gated to tenant admins only. We should spec RBAC.
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Agree — RBAC adds a bit of complexity but doable in the model policy layer. Add to spec.
Maya Chen (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll ping ClearHarbor after PRD is up and confirm enablement invite. :thumbsup:
Ethan Rivera (PM): :+1: I'll update roadmap board and link CH-2201.
ci-bot: Comment added to CH-2201: "include smoke-test prompt set and finance CSV schema."
